atoms.sound: Hey Francesco. This is my first time travelling by plane and I am a bit nervous about the whole airport process. Can you walk me through it?

Don’t worry. It’s actually pretty straightforward. First, you need to go to the check-in counter to check any large baggage. They’ll also give you your boarding pass there. You could also do this at a self-check-in machine.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. And what about the security check? What do I need to do there?

At security, you’ll need to take liquids out of your bag and empty your pockets. Once you’re past security, you can relax a bit and check a departures board to find your gate. When it’s time to board, have your passport and boarding pass ready.
